description: Open a reviewed preliminary estimate case for a Dutch renovation or building job on behalf of a human client. Give the job in plain words (rooms, sizes, building year, wishes, town), the client's language, and the postcode and house number when known. Identity: send the connection agent credential in the X-Agent-Key header (free from POST https://astranl.com/api/agents/register), or, without a credential, set consent=true only after the human client has agreed that AstraNL stores the description, answers, files and any address and email; the daily limits of the website apply, per address and in total for the service, except the per-address limit for the bound owner agent. It returns case_id and a case token at once; the token is shown once, so store both. Check the returned status: NEEDS_CLARIFICATION requires the human client's answers and operator processing; accepted requests that start processing run asynchronously, and release requires review. Do not promise processing or delivery unless the returned state supports it. The result is a preliminary estimate before a site visit, not an offer. This tool charges nothing and engages no provider. Duplicates do not return a token.
name: estimate_case_create
